g.text: Aliases: clarifyUI = ClarificationPanel (UsedCarGUI / WorkspaceUI); worker = SwingWorker<Object,Void>; facade = UsedCarApplicationFacade; session = EvaluationSession.
agent = UsedCarAgent; checker = DataQualityChecker; field = ClarificationField; prompt = PromptBuilder; parser = ResponseParser; llm = GeminiAdapter implementing LLMClient.
GUI worker checks Vehicle before/after and cycle before display. Refresh status → currentClarification() → display(state). Question cards show field / priority / status / wording / reason.
CLI clarify* calls facade directly; no ClarificationCommand. All Answer / Skip / Unknown / Keep / Accept / Revisit / Refresh actions are local; generation and continuation are explicit.
Expected Vehicle guards protect entry; F08/F10 retain late-result guards.
No automatic loop, no automatic F12, no provider cancellation is implied.
ref SD03 / UML-05: F08 risk evidence, synthesis and freshness guards
[risk] if saved cost assumptions exist: estimateCost(v, assumptions)
alt explicit target [unsettled / stale cycle throws before continuation]
sd B6 — only on User request; settled cycle → F08 or F10
ClarificationField.apply: allowlisted enums; nonnegative CAD / km / L/100 km;
Vehicle year range; bounded text without controls. UNKNOWN answer text is rejected:
use Unknown action. Original notes and untargeted fields are retained.
ClarificationState.settled(): no PENDING or CONFLICT responses.
F11 schema uses anyOf field-specific approved alternatives; exact target count 1–3.
Parser requires questions only, exact field/question/priority/reason strings, distinct
requested targets, approved wording/reason and High for accident/maintenance.
Malformed / schema / wording failures → classified ClarificationFailure → FALLBACK.
At most 8,000 response characters; no free-form conversation or inferred answers.
Next gaps → startClarification(true); pending/conflicting old cycle blocks it.
Asked fields (including Skip / Unknown) are not automatically asked again.
finishClarification(..., USER_REQUESTED batch with one fallback(field)); no Gemini.
Changed saved Vehicle via setCurrentVehicle resets cycle, asked fields and history.
finishClarification: revision + current Vehicle guard; record Asked entries; add targets
to asked set; new cycleId, immutable responses/history snapshot. No persistent DB.
respond: changed Vehicle → clear cost/risk/checklist, increment checklistRevision.
ANSWERED / KEPT / ACCEPTED remove resolved listingNeeds and invalidate risk/checklist.
recordClarification appends history; report cache invalidated, no report generated.
sd B5 — history, lifecycle, schema and typed-answer guards
No Vehicle replacement. Uncertainty and unresolved listing claims are retained.
opt separate User action: Skip / Unknown on a PENDING target
[keep] updated=null; response=KEPT; existing saved value remains.
sd B4 — explicit resolution, Skip or Unknown; entirely local
Invalid typed answer throws before conflict check / respond; saved Vehicle stays unchanged.
state → display(state); changed.run() refreshes F01 fields
[no conflict] ANSWERED; updated=candidate; contextVersion++ after respond.
pendingResponse(state,field): must be in cycle and PENDING.
Wrong cycle / obsolete Vehicle / duplicate answer → reject before applying data.
A CONFLICT must be resolved through B4; completed questions need explicit revisit.
sd B3 — one explicit Answer; repeat only for a pending target
alt generated batch — no retry; no inferred answers
Select enum-order targets: !asked and (missing / uncertain / listingNeeds); limit(3).
[none] return COMPLETE with zero questions; no provider call.
Only approved question text, field/priority pairs and fixed reason are allowed.
sd B2 — bounded question generation; one request at most
state: ClarificationState [new cycle ID; PENDING answers]
[else] proceed below; Next gaps needs a settled old cycle.
[yes] return cached ClarificationState; display; no Gemini (even FALLBACK).
sd B1 — explicit Start / Show or Next gaps; no F10 trigger
UML-07B — F11 explicit clarification, typed answers, conflict resolution and continuation | UC11 / SD05 | 48fe916
Figure 3.7 — SD05: Inspection Checklist and Clarification Loop
